rules.title: Strict Platform Isolation: 100% Native SwiftUI (Rule 1)
rules.description: Under no circumstances import Compose Multiplatform or Compose Runtime in iosApp. The iOS client must remain 100% native SwiftUI. All communication with shared logic must route through IntercomBridge.kt with CancellationHandle subscription lifecycle tied to view deinit.

rules.title: Pure Multiplatform Logic & Cryptography (Rules 2 & 3)
rules.description: Code in commonMain must have zero platform-specific Java (java.*, javax.*, java.security.*) or C/JNI dependencies. Cryptographic algorithms (ChaCha20-Poly1305, SHA-256) must be written in pure Kotlin so they compile identically across Android, iOS Native, JVM, and Wasm/JS.

rules.title: Broadcast Storm Suppression & Deduplication
rules.description: Every incoming packet (Audio, Control, Relay) MUST be checked against PacketDeduplicator.shouldProcess(packet) before local processing or multi-hop forwarding. When serializing MeshPacket hierarchies, always use Json { classDiscriminator = '#type' } to prevent field collision with ControlType.

rules.title: Android Foreground Service & Power Lifecycle
rules.description: Foreground services must declare foregroundServiceType='connectedDevice|microphone' in AndroidManifest.xml. Partial WakeLocks must be acquired with explicit timeouts or guaranteed release in onDestroy(). Navigation 3 AppNavGraph must provide SavedStateConfiguration registering polymorphic NavKey routes.

rules.title: Structured Concurrency & State Safety
rules.description: Avoid GlobalScope.launch. Use structured CoroutineScope or supervisorScope with explicit cancellation. Protect mutable state shared across threads with Mutex or atomic StateFlow. Never block the main thread with synchronous Bluetooth or audio I/O.
